identity.description: Instance-based lazy learner: prediction is a (distance-weighted) vote or mean over the k closest training rows. There is no real fit — training memorizes the data and builds a spatial index; ALL modeling effort happens at query time in the distance metric.

consumes.note: distances over one-hot categoricals are legal but semantically weak — each category contributes a fixed √2 step regardless of similarity

emits.note: neighbor vote fractions — quantized to multiples of 1/k, so the probability surface is coarse and needs external calibration for threshold work
regression mode — (distance-weighted) mean of neighbor targets

learnsVsFixed.note: learns in the memorization sense: the 'model' IS the training set plus an index; artifact size scales with n

leaf_size.note: index-build/query tradeoff only; never changes predictions

invariances.why: Minkowski distance sums per-feature differences in raw units — a feature measured in cents contributes 100x the metric weight of the same feature in dollars, silently owning the neighborhood
monotone maps preserve per-feature ORDER but not distances; log-transforming a feature reshapes every neighborhood
distance to a missing coordinate is undefined; sklearn raises on NaN input
the metric needs numeric coordinates; categoricals must be encoded before distances exist
purely nonparametric — the only assumption is LOCALITY: that nearby points share labels
no fit cost, but every prediction pays O(log n)–O(n·p) query cost and the artifact stores the full training set; large n makes serving heavy, and high p degrades the tree indexes toward brute force
predictions are votes/means over training targets — outputs can never leave the convex hull of observed target values, and far-away queries just inherit the nearest edge of the data

featureStats.why: the distance metric weights features by raw variance — a max/min variance ratio far from 1 means one feature owns the neighborhood, the mechanism-level signal that scaling is load-bearing here
in high dimension pairwise distances concentrate (nearest ≈ farthest), destroying the locality signal the vote depends on — the curse-of-dimensionality gate
prediction cost and artifact size are both O(n); a large training set makes a lazy learner expensive exactly where eager models get cheap

modelMetrics.why: if the k-th neighbor is far, 'neighbors' are not local and the vote averages unrelated rows — a direct measurement of whether the locality assumption holds
a CV curve that never plateaus in k means no stable neighborhood structure exists — the signal to commit a global (parametric or tree) family instead

edgeCases.behavior: highest-variance feature dominates the metric; other features become noise
distance concentration — neighborhoods lose meaning, accuracy collapses toward prior
every prediction is the global majority/mean — model degenerates to a constant

edgeCases.condition: very large n at serving time
edgeCases.behavior: per-query latency and artifact size grow with the training set
edgeCases.note: note the memory/latency cost; prefer an eager family when serving volume is high

edgeCases.behavior: tie broken by neighbor order — arbitrary-looking flips near boundaries
edgeCases.note: prefer odd k for binary problems

driver.wrapperNeeds: none (sklearn-compatible fit/predict/predict_proba); fit is memorization + index build, near-instant
driver.serializationNote: the pickle embeds the ENTIRE training matrix — artifact size ~ training-set size, unlike every parametric family
driver.threadSafety: predict parallel via n_jobs; index is read-only after fit, thread-safe

canBeSeeds.note: calibration smooths the 1/k-quantized vote fractions into usable probabilities

placementClaims.why: no native NaN handling — distance to a missing coordinate is undefined and sklearn raises
not monotone-invariant: symmetrizing heavy-skewed features stops a long tail from stretching one axis of the metric
scale-sensitive by mechanism — the metric IS a unit-weighted sum; without standardization the highest-variance feature decides every neighborhood
categoricals must be numeric before a distance exists at all
